title: Naondoka gym baada ya dakika 5, lakini naweza kuruka dakika 45 kwenye gym ya trampolini
label: Dakika 45 za kuruka

text.Before, I talked about a gym called Anyt: Hapo awali nilizungumzia gym inayoitwa Anytime Fitness.
text.But I am someone who really quits after: Lakini mimi ni mtu ambaye huacha kweli baada ya takribani dakika tano ninapoenda gym.
text.If anything, I am the kind of person who: Kwa kweli, mimi ni mtu anayeenda gym kuoga zaidi kuliko kufanya mazoezi.
text.I really do it for 5 or 10 minutes, thin: Nafanya mazoezi kwa dakika tano au kumi tu, nawaza “sawa, nimemaliza,” ninaoga na kurudi nyumbani.
text.But I did not want that, and I wanted to: Lakini sikutaka kuendelea hivyo; nilitaka kufanya mazoezi vizuri.
Kwa hiyo nilienda JUMP ONE, gym ya trampolini.
Sasa limekuwa zoea la kufurahisha sana.
text.What kind of place is it? You jump on a: Ni sehemu ya aina gani? Unaruka kwenye trampolini ukifuata muziki.
text.The difference from a normal gym is that: Tofauti na gym ya kawaida ni kwamba unaendelea kusogea kwenye trampolini kwa dakika 45 kamili.
text.It is during a lesson, so the teacher is: Ni darasa, kwa hiyo mwalimu anakuangalia na watu walio karibu nawe pia wanakuangalia.
text.So you have to keep moving for 45 minute: Kwa hiyo unapaswa kuendelea kusogea kwa dakika 45.
text.When I go to a gym alone, I always end u: Nikienda gym peke yangu, huwa namaliza baada ya takribani dakika tano.
text.I thought it is good that there is real: Nadhani ni vizuri kuwe na msukumo wa kweli, ili niweze kuendelea kufanya mazoezi kwa dakika 45.
text.You can choose from many kinds of lesson: Unaweza kuchagua aina nyingi za madarasa na viwango mbalimbali.
text.There are many instructors, and each one: Kuna wakufunzi wengi, na kila mmoja ana mtindo wake.
text.An instructor who comes right in front o: Mkufunzi anayekuja mbele kabisa ya trampolini yangu na kunitia moyo kwa nguvu
text.An instructor who teaches while singing,: Mkufunzi anayeonekana mwenye furaha sana na kufundisha huku akiimba
text.An instructor who is really good at gett: Mkufunzi anayejua sana jinsi ya kuwachangamsha wote
text.Each instructor has their own personalit: Kila mkufunzi ana utu wake, na hilo linafurahisha.
Ndani ya ukumbi pia kuna harufu nzuri.
Kwa vyovyote vile, utatokwa na jasho kama maporomoko ya maji.
text.In 45 minutes, you can sweat an unbeliev: Katika dakika 45 unaweza kutokwa na jasho jingi ajabu.
text.On days when I think \"I will work hard: Siku ninapofikiria “leo nitajitahidi,” nahudhuria madarasa mawili na kuruka kwa dakika 90 mfululizo.
text.I jump to the music, following the instr: Ninaruka kwa kufuata muziki na mienendo ya mkufunzi.
text.After jumping, sweating a lot, and takin: Baada ya kuruka, kutokwa na jasho jingi na kuoga.
Wakati huo huwa unajisikia vizuri sana.
Limekuwa mojawapo ya mambo ninayopenda zaidi.
text.When I go to a gym alone, I touch the du: Nikienda gym peke yangu, ninashika dumbbell kwa dakika tano hivi na tayari naridhika.
text.So when I choose a gym from now on, I th: Kwa hiyo nikichagua gym siku zijazo, nafikiri mazoezi na mkufunzi binafsi au kufanya mazoezi pamoja na wengine kunaweza kunifaa sana.
Kwa sababu hapo unautumia mwili wako kweli.
Nilifikiri huenda hilo likawa jambo zuri.
